raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #58742. Resolved quantization names missing from the estimator lookup silently drop attention and FFN work from MFU/MBU estimates.

## Claims

- Resolve weight size from GPTQ/AWQ bit widths, online quantization specifications, and mixed linear/expert precision.
- Retain components with a deduplicated warning and model-dtype estimate when an unsupported method or checkpoint layer selection cannot be represented by one width.
- Preserve existing supported methods and unquantized controls.

## Validation

Rebased onto current main `276fbcf`, resolving the upstream move of `Self` into `typing`. Implementation and test bodies are unchanged from the previously tested branch.

```bash
OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest --confcutdir=tests/v1/metrics tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py -q
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files vllm/v1/metrics/perf.py tests/v1/metrics/test_perf_metrics.py
```

**100 metrics tests passed.** All applicable pre-commit checks passed, including the repository's minimum-version mypy check.

Executed 16 real checkpoint/flag combinations six times against the rebased stack: **96 online runs passed**, each evaluating prefill and decode. A separate 16-case run used the unpatched current-main estimator with identical checkpoint revisions, configuration hashes, and resolved layer lists. All repeats were identical; unaffected controls and the previously approved estimates were unchanged.

| Checkpoint | Upstream decode GFLOPs | Patched decode GFLOPs |
|---|---:|---:|
| GPT-OSS-20B | 1.158 | 7.436 |
| Qwen2.5 GPTQ/AWQ | 0.272 | 1.076 |
| Qwen3 bf16 control | 1.427 | 1.427 |

Validation used Python 3.12 and CPU Torch with actual `ModelConfig`, `VllmConfig._get_quantization_config`, and estimator execution. No weights were loaded or GPU inference run; model outputs, kernels, and serving behavior are unchanged.

## Details

Both attention and FFN parsers share weight-size resolution. GPT-OSS retains bf16 linear layers and FP4 expert accounting; DeepSeek-V4's FFN accounting is restored while its separate unsupported attention architecture remains outside this fix.

The fallback can overestimate weight traffic and does not provide per-layer accounting. Automatically discovered layer lists in the tested Qwen GPTQ/AWQ checkpoints trigger the documented 2-byte fallback rather than assuming every projection is 4-bit.

No overlapping fix was found in issue-number or area searches. Related #58745, #58836, and #54228 address speculative-token accounting, hybrid attention, and expert activation counts respectively.

<details>
<summary>Pull Request Checklist</summary>

- [x] Design Fit: confines changes to the analytic estimator and shares resolution between its parsers.
- [x] Testing and Validation: regression coverage and real configuration execution passed; upstream CI remains maintainer-authorized.
- [x] Code Quality and Style: current pre-commit and type checks passed.
- [x] Pull Request Contents: issue, reproducer commands, results, and limitations are included.

</details>

+def _get_quantized_weight_byte_size(
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+    default_byte_size: float,
+    layer_kinds: tuple[Literal["linear", "moe"], ...] = ("linear",),
+) -> float:
+    cfg = vllm_config.quant_config
+    if cfg is None:
+        return default_byte_size
+
+    quant_method = cfg.get_name()
+    byte_sizes: set[float] = set()
+    if quant_method == "auto_gptq":
+        gptq_cfg = cast("AutoGPTQConfig", cfg)
+        if not gptq_cfg.dynamic and not gptq_cfg.modules_in_block_to_quantize:
+            return gptq_cfg.weight_bits / 8
+    elif quant_method == "auto_awq":
+        awq_cfg = cast("AutoAWQConfig", cfg)
+        if not awq_cfg.modules_to_not_convert:
+            return awq_cfg.weight_bits / 8
+    elif quant_method in _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE:
+        return _QUANT_WEIGHT_BYTE_SIZE[quant_method]
+    elif quant_method == "gpt_oss_mxfp4":
+        byte_sizes = {
+            0.5 if kind == "moe" else default_byte_size for kind in layer_kinds
+        }
+    elif quant_method == "deepseek_v4_fp8":
+        expert_dtype = getattr(
+            vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config, "expert_dtype", "fp4"
+        )
+        if expert_dtype in ("fp4", "fp8"):
+            byte_sizes = {
+                0.5 if kind == "moe" and expert_dtype == "fp4" else 1
+                for kind in layer_kinds
+            }
+    elif quant_method == "online":
+        quant_args = cast("OnlineQuantizationConfig", cfg).args
+        # A component has one weight size, so per-layer overrides cannot be
+        # represented by the current estimator.
+        if not quant_args.targets and not quant_args.ignore:
+            for kind in layer_kinds:
+                spec = getattr(quant_args, kind)
+                if spec is None or spec.weight is None:
+                    byte_sizes.add(default_byte_size)
+                else:
+                    dtype = spec.weight.dtype
+                    if isinstance(dtype, ScalarType):
+                        byte_sizes.add(dtype.size_bits / 8)
+                    elif dtype == FP4_DTYPE:
+                        # FP4 storage packs two logical weights into one uint8.
+                        byte_sizes.add(0.5)
+                    else:
+                        byte_sizes.add(get_dtype_size(dtype))
